title: Patch: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes III
notes: The designer's third Stinkyscape+ balance pass (#4154). Burn now ticks once at the end of every turn and is removed (R4154000); Toxopid Legs are Immune to Toxic (R4154001). Costs, stats, keywords and Tributes on about 35 cards; script changes, each keeping its v0.6.6g script (R767000), on Profe Yates, Selective Enrollment, The Last Voyage, Endless Expedition, Taotie, NA Tech, Jlockeed Shredder-12, Appropriations, Halo, Occidentless Mandate, Repeater v5, A Glimpse into the Endless Sea, Last Hurrah, Disruptive Disruptor, Alteran Reach, Job Application, The Trade Union, Expedition123, Z'Zoth, Goetzmann Game Design, Double Counting, CN Jade Well, Spiteful Stab, Toxopid, Toxopid Leg, Crawler, Shawarma Law, the Training-Grounds and Meditative Calls to Chaos, Eclipse, xxFreshJack, Ocean Tsunami, Imitated Instrumentality and Introspection; Spice sells higher. The AI trades, sells Spice, aims Living Bomb and uses Feng Shui better. Rulings R4154000, R4154001, R4154100-R4154105, R4154200-R4154213, R4154300-R4154305, R4154400-R4154403.

player.title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes III
balance: Burn now deals its damage once, at the end of the turn, and is then removed (it used to tick at the start of its owner's turn and drop by 3).
Tommy Tempo is 3/3 (Radiant 6/6), down from 4/4 (Radiant 8/8).
JC Backed costs (4), up from (3).
Beam v3 deals 4 damage (Radiant 8), Beam v4 6 (Radiant 12) and Beam v5 8 (Radiant 16), each down from 5, 7 and 9 (Radiant 10, 14 and 18).
Fuse costs (3), up from (2); CN Flea Market (2), up from (1); Drone Core IX (7), up from (6); Snom Bunny Mind Control (6), up from (5).
Midlane Menace is 2/2 (Radiant 4/4), down from 3/3 (Radiant 6/6); Straaza is 6/6 (Radiant 12/12), down from 8/8 (Radiant 16/16).
Silly Silas is 7/7 (Radiant 14/14), up from 4/4 (Radiant 8/8).
Tmack Trav is 7/7 (Radiant 14/14), down from 8/8 (Radiant 16/16); The Propagation's Hornet is 1/3 (Radiant 2/6), down from 2/3 (Radiant 4/6).
Book of Buff Buffs 3 times (Radiant 6), down from 4 (Radiant 8).
K-Pop Fanatic costs (3), up from (2), and loses Can't Defend.
Outbreak costs (3), up from (1), and places 2 Plague Counters (Radiant 4), up from 1 (Radiant 2).
Imitated Instrumentality and Introspection cost (3), down from (4), and each needs Tribute 1.
Ocean Tsunami needs Tribute 2, up from 1; xxFreshJack gains Tribute 1.
League of Losers' five Losers are each 3/3 (Radiant 6/6).
Orca is no longer a Starship Piece.
Open Enrollment costs (0), Feng Shui (2), Lockdown (1), Living Bomb (3), Basket of Crawlers (1), Field of Dreams (0) and Memory Leak (1); Lockdown gains Crater.
Eclipse is 9/17 (Radiant 18/34), its Radiant Armor is 6 (Radiant Reignclipse's Armor 3 is 6 too) and its damage Burns 7 (Radiant 14).
Tatches the Totem is 0/4 (Radiant 0/8); Arm of the Jempire is 3/8 (Radiant 6/16).
Jayaad is a Human; Toxopid Legs are Immune to Toxic.
Repeater v5's Activate can be used 3 times a turn, down from 4.
Jlockeed Shredder-12 needs Tribute 3, up from 2, and a Float lowers it by 1.
Appropriations' four choices are weaker again on both faces.
Call to Chaos (Mindustrial-Swarm Edition): its card counts drop by one (Paperclip 2, Evolved Swarm 2, Jlockeed 3, Terminus 2) and its Burn to 1.
Call to Chaos (Training-Grounds Edition): both Rush entries summon 2 Rush Tokens, down from 3; it replenishes 2 mana, down from 3, and gives 5 mana, down from 6.
Call to Chaos (Training-Grounds Edition) adds 3 Training Grounds cards, down from 4, and summons 4 permanents, down from 5.
Call to Chaos (Meditative Edition): your hero gains 4 Armor and heals 4, down from 5.
Alteran Reach costs (1), up from (0).
Spice sells for about 25% more Credits at the Marketplace.
Expedition123 also gives your hero 2 Armor (Radiant 4).
Goetzmann Game Design's card costs (1) less.
CN Jade Well's Auspicious Rocks come with Lucky 1.
Spiteful Stab gains Pierce.
Dungeon run: a tier-1 Elite now draws every turn and has 18 health, up from every other turn and 16.
changes: Profe Yates's Cry exiles a permanent with M, O, U, S and E in its name and text (CN cards are immune; a face-down card never qualifies), and Yates has no Activates any more.
Selective Enrollment costs (5), up from (4), and Float reduces its cost.
The Last Voyage's base face no longer launches a Starship as it resolves: one launches at the start of each of your turns.
Endless Expedition: for the rest of the game you have (1) less mana, and at the start of each of your turns you add a random Terminus card (Radiant: Radiant) that costs (3). It adds none at once.
饕餮's base Activate has an extra turn cooldown.
NA Tech's fused card costs what the fusion costs, at most (4), instead of a set price.
Halo's Cry: three times, choose one of 2 Weapons and Equip it into Halo.
Occidentless Mandate destroys instead of exiling.
A Glimpse into the Endless Sea also exiles every permanent on the field.
Last Hurrah no longer discards at the end of the turn; the Radiant face gives 4 random cards in your hand Flashback.
Disruptive Disruptor loses its Cry and gains Activate: your opponent discards a random card (Radiant: a random Radiant card, or any card if they hold none).
Alteran Reach: your first travel each turn is free (Radiant: your first two).
Job Application hears back in 1 to 2 turns, and its Interview asks for 2 cards of different costs or a hit of 8 or more.
The Trade Union lets you Trade up to 2 cards each turn (Radiant 3).
Z'Zoth triggers the Deaths of the Units it summons (Radiant: twice).
Double Counting gains Activate: pay (1) to Discover a Cry or Death card (Radiant: free).
Toxopid's Legs land in random empty zones (Radiant: on your opponent's side); it no longer adds a Crawler, and a Crawler dying no longer cheapens it.
Crawler is a (1) 3/1 (Radiant 6/2) you may play from your graveyard for (1); it lost Can't Defend, its death after attacking and its old Death.
Crawler's Death adds a Toxopid to your hand, or cheapens the one you hold by (2) (Radiant (3)).
Shawarma Law: a Unit eats at most three Shawarmas.
The AI trades cards it cannot play soon, sells Spice, aims Living Bomb at your permanents and takes Feng Shui's Rock every turn.
